# Python dependencies of the CI test and fmt jobs.
#
# Used by actions/setup-python as the cache key (cache: pip) so the runner does
# not re-download the tools on every run.  Versions are pinned so that the
# checks are reproducible: `verible==0.0.4071.0` is the formatter version the
# Verilog sources were formatted with, and ruff/pytest match the local
# toolchain.  Dependabot proposes updates for this file (see
# .github/dependabot.yml); bump the pins deliberately and run `make fmt` if the
# formatter changes.
pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.17.1
verible==0.0.4071.0
